'''Torog''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] who competed in the [[Besberra arena|arena]] on [[Besberra]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> Torog fought off waves of wild animals and opponents for an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] before their neck was broken, but the Houk somehow managed to continue fighting for another four hours until they dropped [[Death/Legends|dead]]. A post-mortem autopsy was conducted on Torog after the fight that determined that their neck had been broken an hour into the fight, and the discovery gained Torog posthumous fame.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torog was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Houk [[Species/Legends|species]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
